mapper.select: SELECT e.alert_event_id,e.integration_id,i.integration_code,i.integration_name, e.external_event_id,e.event_type,e.fingerprint,e.alert_cycle_ref AS cycle_ref, e.occurred_at,e.received_at,e.disposition,e.incident_id,e.raw_body_sha256, e.summary,e.correlation_id FROM alert_event e JOIN monitoring_integration i ON i.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND i.integration_id=e.integration_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.integration_id=#{integrationId} AND e.external_event_id=#{externalEventId}

SELECT e.alert_event_id,e.integration_id,i.integration_code,i.integration_name, e.external_event_id,e.event_type,e.fingerprint,e.alert_cycle_ref AS cycle_ref, e.occurred_at,e.received_at,e.disposition,e.incident_id,e.raw_body_sha256, e.summary,e.correlation_id FROM alert_event e JOIN monitoring_integration i ON i.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND i.integration_id=e.integration_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND e.alert_cycle_ref=#{cycleRef} AND e.event_type='RESOLVED' AND e.incident_id IS NULL ORDER BY e.received_at,e.alert_event_id LIMIT 1

SELECT e.alert_event_id,e.integration_id,i.integration_code,i.integration_name, e.external_event_id,e.event_type,e.fingerprint,e.alert_cycle_ref AS cycle_ref, e.occurred_at,e.received_at,e.disposition,e.incident_id,e.raw_body_sha256, e.summary,e.correlation_id FROM alert_event e JOIN monitoring_integration i ON i.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND i.integration_id=e.integration_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND e.incident_id IS NULL AND e.event_type='FIRING' AND e.occurred_at>#{recoveredAt} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incident n JOIN alert_event f ON f.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND f.alert_event_id=n.first_event_id WHERE n.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND n.fingerprint=e.fingerprint AND f.alert_cycle_ref=e.alert_cycle_ref) ORDER BY e.occurred_at,e.alert_event_id

SELECT e.alert_event_id,e.integration_id,i.integration_code,i.integration_name, e.external_event_id,e.event_type,e.fingerprint,e.alert_cycle_ref AS cycle_ref, e.occurred_at,e.received_at,e.disposition,e.incident_id,e.raw_body_sha256, e.summary,e.correlation_id FROM alert_event e JOIN monitoring_integration i ON i.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND i.integration_id=e.integration_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.alert_event_id=#{eventId}
mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident rn JOIN alert_event rf ON rf.tenant_id=rn.tenant_id AND rf.alert_event_id=rn.first_event_id WHERE rn.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND rn.fingerprint=e.fingerprint AND rf.alert_cycle_ref=e.alert_cycle_ref)=1
